message.content: {"pharmakon_274e":{"rendering":"elixir","gloss":"elixir (a prepared potion)","category":"elixir/potion","note":"Fowler's phrase is 'an elixir of memory and wisdom'. He does not render it as a remedy or a poison, so the pharmakon's ambiguity is lost."},"mneme_274e":{"rendering":"memory","gloss":"memory","note":"The Greek genitive is rendered 'of memory'. Fowler also paraphrases the verb 'will improve their memories' for μνημονικωτέρους just before."},"sophia_274e":{"rendering":"wisdom","gloss":"wisdom","note":"Used in 'elixir of memory and wisdom'. The same word renders σοφωτέρους ('wiser') just before."},"pharmakon_275a":{"rendering":"elixir","gloss":"elixir (a prepared potion)","category":"elixir/potion","note":"Same word as at 274e: 'You have invented an elixir not of memory, but of reminding'. The verb is 'invented' where Theuth's was 'discovered'."},"mneme_275a":{"rendering":"memory","gloss":"memory","note":"Rendered 'not of memory', the same word as at 274e."},"hypomnesis_275a":{"rendering":"reminding","gloss":"reminding (verbal noun)","note":"A gerund-like form that keeps the verbal, active sense. It is not 'reminder', so it does not suggest a written aid."},"sophia_275a":{"rendering":"the appearance of wisdom","gloss":"the outward look/semblance of wisdom","note":"'not true wisdom' renders οὐκ ἀλήθειαν, with the contrast supplied by 'true wisdom'. δόξα becomes 'appearance'."},"doxosophoi_275b":{"rendering":"only appear wise","gloss":"merely seem wise","note":"The compound noun δοξόσοφοι is turned into a verb phrase ('they are not wise, but only appear wise'). The coinage is lost."},"argument":"Fowler keeps the same word, 'elixir', for both occurrences of pharmakon, so Thamus does turn Theuth's own term against him. But 'elixir' presents the pharmakon as a prepared potion and drops its ambiguity between remedy and poison. The contrast between memory and reminding is kept, and 'appearance of wisdom' and 'only appear wise' keep the seeming-versus-being contrast, though the compound δοξόσοφοι is dissolved."}
